The primary objective of the Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB) is to achieve and maintain price stability.

Without prejudice to its primary objective, the Magyar Nemzeti Bank preserves financial stability and supports the Government’s economic policy, as well as its policy on environmental sustainability.

Market participants’ attention was focused on expectations for interest rate policies of the world’s leading central banks, the US debt ceiling, and macroeconomic data releases, in addition to the events relating to the bank failure.

Both the Federal Reserve (Fed) and the European Central Bank (ECB) raised their policy rates by 25 basis points.

Based on market expectations, the Fed is nearing the end of its tightening cycle while the ECB may raise its policy rate further in a few more steps.
